purpose: Pin the official Obsidian desktop build used for GitHub Actions reference-runner feasibility and later C01.2 reopen acceptance.
current_probe_scope: Verify that the pinned official Obsidian desktop renderer starts under Xvfb on GitHub Actions and preserve its DOM text, screenshot and process log as feasibility evidence.
acceptance_limitations: The runner probe does not create or reopen a vault.
The runner probe does not satisfy C01.2-01 or C01.2-03.
A later workflow must use a privacy-safe fixture, launch OpenObsidian against the same vault, reopen that vault in Obsidian, and compare source bytes and allowed workspace-state changes.
